Kosice Neologist Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Rastislavova 87, Slovakia

Not demolished. This record likely duplicates an entry already documented for Košice's Neologist cemetery elsewhere in this collection, sharing the same location and history — flagged here rather than treated as an entirely distinct site. This is Košice's Neologist Jewish cemetery, divided between an older, larger section and a smaller newer one, still in active use and holding about 3,800 tombstones, among the largest sites documented in this collection. Not marked on an 1880s Austro-Hungarian map, its oldest preserved tombstone, dated 1889, suggests it was founded no later than the late 19th century.
